mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.25%) signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.25%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 10.0% for three consecutive months signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE > 10.0% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate housing sector contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when RSAFS and HOUST both decline for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly real GDP expansion (GDPC1 > 13000.0) indicates robust economic growth that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when GDPC1 > 13000.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly core CPI increase above 215.0 signals accelerating inflation that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 215.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate severe labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 100.0, it signals manufacturing expansion that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when INDPRO > 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
